## 维护者速读
报表、报表目录和自定义页面改用和列表、仪表盘一样的页面头部；右上角按钮组（评论位、编辑应用、AI、帮助）已经做好，但默认关着，只有浏览器里的测试开关能打开，手机上从不出现，所以合并后大家看到的只有这几个页面多了头部。代码我读完了，没有必须改的地方，作者自己写的页面头部平台一律不藏。还差两样才能给最终结论：CI 跑完全绿，以及截图（报表、自定义页面改动前后，按钮组打开时的样子）。

## 席位核对 — HOLD (L1-c, code read clean) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `a7c20650` · 2026-11-21T15:44Z

**Card:** `Fixes #36111`. Claim 7064613161 (amended: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, the one new export `PageTitleHostContext` in `@object-ui/components`). Ruling 7064921354 is option 1, with Fable's read at `fable-decision.md`. No `packages/spec/src/**` or `docs/adr/**` in the diff, so the seat runs the declared L2.

**Gates, not yet final:**
- CI on `a7c20650` was 13 success · 10 skipped · 32 in progress when I read it, so `l1-face` is INCOMPLETE (floor-checks and all-checks not measured).
- `a7c20650` merges `3c06fc53` (main) with an empty `--remerge-diff`.

**The four points asked:**
1. **No authored `page:header` is hidden.**
   - `PageTitleHostContext` turns off only the renderer's implicit title and description (`showPageTitle`, `showPageDescription`).
   - An authored titled `page:header` draws as before; under `PageTitleDemotedContext` only its tag goes from `h1` to `h2`, with the same classes.
   - The provider resets to `false` inside the page, so a nested page draws its own title.
   - The description is not drawn twice: `showPageDescription` is off under the host, so `headerDrawsDescription` is off too.
   - The only author edits are `my-work` and `project-workspace`. Each drops a `title` equal to its page name, keeps its subtitle, and comments why. That matches the ruling, and the pin "authored title stays as an `h2`" covers it.
2. **The group is off by default.**
   - `SHELL_PAGE_ACTIONS_DEFAULT = false`.
   - `readShellPageActionsSwitch` reads only `localStorage['os:shell:page-actions'] === 'on'`, inside `try`.
   - `useShellPageActionsOn` adds `!phone`.
   - It is never drawn outside `ShellPageActionsScope`, which only `ConsoleLayout` mounts.
   - The record page also leaves it out when `embedded`.
   - All of this is pinned in `ShellPageActions-36111`: the default, the switch, blocked storage, scope and phone. A test also pins that with the switch off the header is unchanged (no group, no hairline, no empty cluster).
3. **Record page against #36114.**
   - `pageFrame` becomes `<>{group}{✕}</>`, so the group sits before ✕.
   - I trial-merged this head with #36114's `09b716c8`: no conflict.
   - The two settle side by side in `RecordTopBar`: `comments={commentsButton}` and `frame={pageFrame}` are separate props.
   - Once the group is on, the comments icon sits before the record's button group, not first inside the shell group as the card's order says. The brief says not to move it here; it is #36112's to settle with the seat.
4. **Name once on reports, html and react pages.**
   - `ReportView` and `AppReportIndexView` drop their own `h1` block for `PageHeader`; the report's Edit becomes the header's action.
   - html and react pages render as the `layoutElement` of the same `PageRenderer`, under the same `showPageTitle` gate, so the host switch removes their implicit title too.
   - By code this holds; the only pin is a section page (`getAllByRole('heading', { level: 1 })` has length 1). I'd like the evidence to show `start-here` (html) and `crm-workbench` (react).

**Also read:**
- `HelpMenu` is a pure move out of `AppHeader`: same items, `leaveTo` through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, the docs fetch, About.
- `useAppStudioEntry` reproduces the pencil's derivation (`activeAppName || currentAppName || params.appName || pathParts[1]`, `pathParts[2]`/`[3]`), so the group's Edit app and the top bar's pencil open the same place.
- `InterfaceListPage` swaps its own row for `PageHeader` only under `consoleHeader` (`!phone`), so Studio's preview keeps its row.
- The four pencil pins now run at 375, where the pencil lives; what they assert is unchanged.

**Owed before ACCEPT:**
- (a) CI green on the final head.
- (b) The evidence the card asks for:
  - report and custom page, before and after;
  - the group on, at list, record, dashboard, report and custom page;
  - a narrow window, so Edit app shows as an icon;
  - light and dark;
  - plus one html and one react page showing the name once.

**Nits, no action needed:**
- `ShellPageActions.tsx`'s module doc still says a custom page draws the group "through the host slot `PageHeaderTrailingContext`" (option C). It now comes from `PageHeader`.
- `PageView.editInStudio*` comments cite `ShellPageActions.pageRoute-36111`; the file is `ShellPageActions-36111.test.tsx`.
- `PageView` names the page `label ?? title`, while `PageRenderer` reads `title ?? label`. A page carrying both, with different values, would now show a different name than before.

Verdict: **HOLD** at `a7c20650`. The code read is clean, and ACCEPT follows once (a) and (b) are in. A new head gets a delta read.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVcCRGjxwhDjrRVYsY

**Evidence for #36111** (head `bbf1849d6`), from a local showcase boot (`objectstack dev --fresh --seed-admin`) with the console's HMR dev server on this branch; "before" is the same boot with the changed `ui/` sources swapped back to `main` (`3c06fc53a`). 1440×900 at 2×, light and dark. The files are in the project's evidence folder `build-seat1/36111/shots/` (44 PNGs); what each shows, read off the rendered DOM after the shot:

**Report and custom pages, before → after** (`before-*.png` / `after-*.png`, each in `-light` and `-dark`)

| surface | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| report `showcase_task_overview` | bespoke title block, no page header | `PageHeader`: report icon, name, description inline, 「Edit」 at the right; one `h1` |
| report index | bespoke `h1` block | `PageHeader` 「Reports」 |
| sections page `showcase_my_work` | renderer's own 「My Work」 `h1` | header 「My Work」, the authored subtitle stays in the body (its duplicate title removed per the ruling); one `h1` |
| sections page `showcase_contact_form` | `h1` 「Get in touch」 (authored) | header `h1` 「Contact Form (SDUI data entry)」, authored 「Get in touch」 unchanged below as `h2` |
| html page `showcase_start_here` | renderer's 「Start Here」 + the author's own big title | header 「Start Here」 + the author's big title; the page name appears **once** |
| react page `showcase_crm_workbench` | renderer's 「CRM Workbench (React)」 above the author's block | header 「CRM Workbench (React)」, the name appears **once** |
| interface page `showcase_active_projects` | its own 18px title row | `PageHeader` 「Active Projects」, the same toolbar and grid below |

**The group turned on** (`localStorage['os:shell:page-actions'] = 'on'`), `after-group-*.png`: one group on each of list (`-light`, `-dark`), record (`-light`, `-dark`), dashboard `showcase_ops_dashboard` (`-light`, `-dark`), report, custom page `showcase_my_work`, interface page. Order: Studio entry, then help (AI is not served by this boot). On the list it ends the view bar after ⋮ behind a hairline; on the record it sits in the navigation row before ✕; elsewhere after the header's own actions.

- The showcase ships as a read-only package, so the Studio entry is the top bar's eye and 「Open Showcase in Studio」 at the same place, as the top bar draws it; the writable 「Edit app」 face (words + `Blocks` icon) is pinned in `ShellPageActions-36111`. On the record route the top bar shows no Studio entry and neither does the group.
- **Narrow window** (900 px, below `lg`): `after-group-list-light-900.png`, `after-group-page-myWork-light-900.png`: the Studio entry is icon-only, the tooltip keeps the words.
- **Off (the default)**: `after-group-off-list-light.png` and every `after-page-*` / `after-report*` shot: no group anywhere, the top bar unchanged.

**Found while shooting, fixed on this branch**: the list page's top row is its view bar since #35878, not `PageHeader`, so the first head drew no group on the list. `4d7b483b4` adds it at the bar's end (pinned in `ObjectView.shellPageActions-36111`, on and off).

## 维护者速读
上一轮要的截图都补齐了，内容没问题：报表、自定义页面（含 html、react 页面）页名只出现一次，按钮组打开后六种页面位置一致，窄窗口收成图标，默认关着。但这个版本的 CI 红了，而且是这个 PR 自己引起的：记录页现在多引用了一个会带出整套元数据加载的模块，十几个原有的记录页测试在加载时就崩了，端到端构建也因此失败。用户界面没有坏，但不能合并，需要把这个引用拆轻。L1 结论：请修改后再审。

## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-c, delta) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `bbf1849d` · 2026-11-21T16:25Z

**Delta read:** `a7c20650..bbf1849d`, on top of HOLD 7065111522.
- `7dac7df9` fixes my three nits. The module doc is corrected, the pin citations now read `ShellPageActions-36111`, and `PageView` names the page `title ?? label`, the renderer's order.
- `4d7b483b` closes a real gap: the list page's top row is the #35878 view bar. `ObjectViewBarTrailing` now ends with the group behind a hairline, only while it is on. It can't draw twice: when the bar hosts the page's name, `ObjectViewPageHeader` is not drawn, and otherwise `PageHeader` draws the group itself. The new pin checks the order and exactly one group, on and off.
- `bbf1849d` is the changeset sentence.
- Nit: `ObjectViewPageHeader` now declares `const shellActions = useShellPageActionsOn();` and never reads it.

**Evidence: closed.** Comment 7065442423 and 44 shots in `build-seat1/36111/shots/`. I read:
- `after-page-html-startHere-light`: the name once, in the header; the author's own title stays in the body.
- `after-group-list-light-900`: at 900 px the Studio entry is icon-only (the read-only eye on the showcase), followed by help.
- `after-group-record-light`: help, then ✕, in the navigation row.
- The table also covers before/after for the report, report index, sections, html, react and interface pages, light and dark, and off by default.

**Must fix: CI is red on `bbf1849d`, caused by this PR.** 15 checks failed: 14 `Test UI` shards and `Build & E2E UI`. The 36 successes include Lint and Type Check.

1. **Unit shards.** Each fails one or two `RecordDetailView.*` files at import, before any test runs. The files include `approvalLock-25934`, `flowDroppedFields-33009`, `approvalRecallGate`, `accessEndedAfterDecision-26589`, `recordIdParamSeed` and `refusedLaunch-9973`. The error is `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'authFetchSpy' before initialization`. The stack runs `ShellPageActions.tsx:34` → `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:35` → `metadataClientFactory.ts:41`, which calls `createAuthenticatedFetch` at module load. These files mock `@object-ui/auth` with a factory that returns a `const` spy declared below the hoisted `vi.mock`. Until now nothing on `RecordDetailView`'s import graph called it during import. The new `import { ShellPageActions, useShellPageActionsOn } from '../layout/ShellPageActions.js'` in `RecordDetailView.tsx` (and in `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`) pulls `MetadataProvider` and its client factory in eagerly.
2. **`Build & E2E UI`.** It fails for the same reason. The `mobile-app-connect-qr` spec's stub bundle fails to build with 245 `MISSING_EXPORT` errors (`"useMetadata" is not exported by …/MetadataProvider.tsx`, the `\0mobile-app-qr:auth` / `:react` stubs), because the record view's graph now reaches modules that spec stubs.

**Suggested shape (your call):** keep the pages' import light.
- Split the scope, the switch and `useShellPageActionsOn` into a module that imports only React and `usePhoneViewport`.
- Let `ShellPageActionsScope` (mounted by `ConsoleLayout`, which already has the heavy graph) hand the group down through that context. `RecordDetailView`, `objectViewPageHeader` and `PageHeader` then render what the context gives and import nothing from `MetadataProvider`.
- Rewriting ~15 test files with `vi.hoisted`, and widening the e2e stubs, would treat the symptom and leave the record view's graph heavier.

**Gates for the next head:** all checks green, and the declared L2 on that head is the seat's.

Verdict: **REWORK** at `bbf1849d`. The evidence and the nits are closed; the CI red is this PR's. A delta read follows.

## 维护者速读
上一轮 CI 红的原因已经修好：记录页、列表页和页面头部不再直接引用按钮组，改由外壳通过一个很轻的接口把按钮组递进来，所以不会再带出整套元数据加载。CI 全绿。截图早已核对过：报表、自定义页面（含 html、react 页面）页名只出现一次；按钮组默认关着，打开后六种页面位置一致，窄窗口时收成图标。L1 结论：接受，可以交给座位跑 L2 并落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-c, final) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `ca3b1bea` · 2026-11-21T16:49Z

**Delta read:** `bbf1849d..ca3b1bea` (one commit), on top of REWORK 7065641823. Everything before it stands as read in 7065111522 and 7065641823.

**The fix:**
- New `layout/shellPageActionsSlot.ts` imports only React and `usePhoneViewport`. It holds `ShellPageActionsSlotContext` (a render function, or `null`) and `useShellPageActionsSlot`, which returns `null` on a phone.
- `ShellPageActionsScope` provides one module-level `renderShellPageActionsGroup` while the group is on, and `null` while it is off. The value is stable, so no consumer re-renders on its account. The function returns `<ShellPageActionsGroup/>`, so the group's hooks run in its own component, not in the header that calls it.
- `PageHeader`, `RecordDetailView` (`!embedded` kept) and `ObjectViewBarTrailing` now import only the slot. `git grep` on the head finds `ShellPageActions.js` imported only by `ConsoleLayout` and `AppHeader`, both of which already carry the metadata graph. So `MetadataProvider` and its module-load `createAuthenticatedFetch` are off the record view's graph again.
- The behaviour is the same: off gives no group and no hairline, a phone gives none, and on draws the same group in the same three places. The pins from the earlier rounds cover all of this, and they pass on this head.
- The unused `shellActions` in `ObjectViewPageHeader` is gone.

**Gates:** CI 49 success · 10 skipped · 0 failed on `ca3b1bea`. The 14 `Test UI` shards and `Build & E2E UI` that were red are green. `l1-face` CLEAN.

**Carried from earlier rounds:**
- `Fixes #36111` is right: the card is delivered whole, with the group off as item 4 asks.
- Not a contract face. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (`PageTitleHostContext`) gets the seat's declared L2 on this head.
- Follow-up for #36112: once the group is on, the #36075 comments icon sits before the record's buttons, not first in the group. The brief keeps it where it is in this PR.

Verdict: **ACCEPT** at `ca3b1bea`. Any new head gets a delta read.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `ca3b1beaa2658462a466d8ec28752a7febd1e90a`
Local-runs: none

Read: the card #36111 body and all four of its comments (triage, claim 7064613161, ruling 7064921354, claim amendment 7065073263); the epic #36107 body; the PR #36131 body and its 27-file list; the net diff `3c06fc53..ca3b1bea`; and the check-runs on the head. The head has 49 check-runs green, 10 skipped and 0 failed. That includes `Check Changeset`, `Type Check UI`, all 16 `Test UI` shards, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. The diff touches no `packages/spec/**`, `docs/adr/**`, skill or other governed path. The only reason this review is owed is the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line, so the face is declaration and the tier is `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Public surface: `@object-ui/components`**
- **`PageTitleHostContext` (new root export): right.** It is a boolean React context with the default `false`, a host switch that no metadata key can reach. With the default `false`, `PageRenderer` is byte-for-byte the old page: `showPageTitle` and `showPageDescription` each gain only an `&& !hostOwnsTitle` term. The renderer resets the context to `false` for its own body, so a page nested inside a hosted page draws its own title again.
- **`PageTitleDemotedContext`: right.** It stays unexported (it is not in `index.ts`). `PageRenderer` provides it as `hostOwnsTitle && pageType !== 'record'`, and only `page:header` reads it. The only change is `h1` to `h2` with the same classes on an authored `explicitTitle`, so nothing the author wrote is hidden. This matches ruling 7064921354.
- **`PageRenderer` and `page:header` props:** unchanged.

**Public surface: `@object-ui/app-shell`**
- The package exports only `.` and `./styles.css`, and `src/index.ts` is not in the diff. So `ShellPageActions`, `ShellPageActionsScope`, `useAppStudioEntry`, `HelpMenu`, `shellPageActionsSlot`, `SHELL_PAGE_ACTIONS_*` and `InterfaceListPage`'s new `consoleHeader` prop are all internal. The changeset calls the group "internal to `@object-ui/app-shell`", which is right.
- The exported components `AppHeader`, `ConsolePageHeader` (`PageHeader`), `ConsoleLayout`, `PageView`, `ReportView` and `RecordDetailView` keep their prop types. Their DOM changes as follows:
  - **`PageHeader` and `ObjectViewBarTrailing`:** they draw the group, behind a hairline, only when a provider value reaches them. Only `ShellPageActionsScope` provides it, and it is `null` unless `localStorage['os:shell:page-actions'] === 'on'`. With the group off, the trailing cluster is the old one (`(pageActions || renderShellGroup) && …`).
  - **`ReportView` and `AppReportIndexView`:** their own title blocks become `PageHeader`. The report's 「Edit」 moves over as the header's action with the same `isAdmin` gate and `data-testid`.
  - **`PageView`:** from the phone breakpoint up it draws `PageHeader` (title, else label, else name; the renderer's order) and sets `PageTitleHostContext`. An interface page gets the header through `InterfaceListPage consoleHeader`, and its own row stays for Studio's preview and phones. The floating pencil is now phone-only.
  - **`RecordDetailView`:** `pageFrame` becomes the group followed by ✕, kept off when `embedded`.
- **`AppHeader`: right.** `HelpMenu` is a verbatim lift: the same five items, `leaveTo` through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, the lazy `meta.getItems('doc')` read and About. The Studio entry now comes from `useAppStudioEntry(isApp, activeAppName)`, and its inputs match the old inline derivation: `activeAppName`, then `currentAppName`, then `params.appName`, then `pathParts[1]`, with `pathParts[2]` and `[3]`.
- The group's `useAppStudioEntry(true)` passes no `activeAppName`. `ConsoleLayout` sets `currentAppName = activeAppName` in an effect, so the two keys converge, and the PR pins "the target equals the pencil's".
- **i18n:** no new key. `topbar.editApp` and `topbar.openAppInStudio` already ship in every locale on `main`.

**Accept-set (what an author can write)**
- No schema, key or accepted value changes.
- `examples/app-showcase` (`private: true`, so it publishes nothing) drops the `page:header` `title` on `my-work` and `project-workspace`. Ruling 7064921354 names exactly these two pages. Both keep their subtitles, and each change carries a comment saying why. This is a content edit, not a protocol change.
- The ruling's other follow-up, the hotcrm sales home, is filed as objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2729.

**Import graph: right.** The red on `bbf1849d` came from `RecordDetailView` importing `ShellPageActions.js`, which made the record view's graph load `MetadataProvider` and run `createAuthenticatedFetch` at module load. At this head the pages import only `shellPageActionsSlot.ts`, which needs only React and `usePhoneViewport`. On the head, `ShellPageActions.js` is imported only by `ConsoleLayout` and `AppHeader`, and the 14 `Test UI` shards and `Build & E2E UI` are green.

### ② Semver level

- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: right.** The PR body and the changeset each carry it line-initial. The one root-export addition is `PageTitleHostContext`. Nothing is removed or re-typed, and no exported prop type changes (see ①).
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** It is in both places. No key, value or metadata type is added, removed or re-meant. The page's `title` and `description` keep their meaning, and the host only changes where they are drawn.
- **Level:** ruling A says the level follows the Metadata-protocol line, and a Clause-② widening alone ships `patch`. The changeset has `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` and `'@object-ui/components': patch`, so it matches. These are the only two published packages the diff moves. The showcase is private. `Check Changeset` is green.
- The changeset prose matches the diff: the headers, the group off by default with its switch, the shared help menu, and the export with its `h2` demotion.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Claim 7064613161, item "Open, to the maintainer"** (pages that draw their own title would show it twice): answered by ruling 7064921354, option A. The build follows it point by point:
  - the renderer's implicit title and description move into the header;
  - an authored `page:header` is drawn as written, as an `h2`;
  - the interface page's own row is replaced;
  - html and react pages get the header through the same `PageRenderer` gate;
  - the two equal-title showcase pages are edited by hand;
  - hotcrm has its card (#2729).
- **Claim amendment 7065073263** (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, one export): matches the diff, see ②.
- **Card item 4, "group off while the top bar stands":** built. `SHELL_PAGE_ACTIONS_DEFAULT = false`. The switch is read once inside `try`, so blocked storage reads off. It is never drawn outside `ShellPageActionsScope` or on a phone. It is pinned in `ShellPageActions-36111` and `ObjectView.shellPageActions-36111`, the latter on and off. The card's acceptance asks for a 「测试开关」 (test switch), so the switch is sanctioned rather than a workaround under Prime Directive 5.
